data.name: Subcraft
data.detailed_description:
Subcraft is a co-op submarine adventure. Pilot your submarine beneath a frozen alien world, explore dangerous caves, mine valuable resources and fight the creatures lurking below.

Bring what you find back to the surface, help rebuild a civilisation trapped in an endless ice age, then prepare your crew to dive even deeper.

Dive Into the Unknown

Your submarine is your crew's lifeline.

Travel together into a vast underground world, navigating submerged caves and stopping along the way to explore on foot. Leave the safety of the sub to mine resources, investigate strange locations and deal with whatever you find down there.

The deeper you go, the more dangerous things become.
Work Together as a Crew

Subcraft is built around multiplayer crews of up to 5 players.

Explore with friends or join other adventurers, then work together to keep your expedition moving. One moment you're peacefully travelling through the depths, the next your crew is scrambling to deal with whatever has gone horribly wrong

Discover a Strange Frozen World

Long ago, humans colonised this planet when it was a lush paradise.

Then they disturbed something living deep beneath the surface.

The creature plunged the planet into an endless ice age, destroying its natural plants and animals and leaving much of civilisation in ruins. The survivors turned to machinery, building mechanical creatures and artificial life to replace what had been lost.

Now, generations later, adventurers are descending beneath the ice in search of the resources needed to rebuild.

Key Features

  • Online multiplayer - Explore the world together aboard a shared submarine.

  • Submarine expeditions - Descend beneath the frozen surface and navigate an underground world.

  • Explore outside the sub - Leave your vessel to explore caves, mine resources, and discover new areas.

  • Fight strange creatures - The depths aren't as empty as humanity once thought.

  • Gather resources - Bring valuable materials back from your expeditions.

  • Quests and characters - Meet the unusual people and mechanical inhabitants of the frozen world.

  • Fishing! - Because saving civilisation can wait when the fish are biting.

  • An expanding world - Discover new places, creatures and mysteries as you venture deeper.

data.short_description: Subcraft is a 2-3 player co-op submarine adventure. Dive beneath a frozen world, explore dangerous caves, mine resources, fight monsters, and help rebuild civilisation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 or equivalent with WebGL 2 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD RX 560, or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: 64-bit Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Sound Card: Core Audio-compatible
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma+
  • Processor: Apple M1+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or dedicated AMD GPU
  • Sound Card: Core Audio-compatible
